For a surface-defect classifier, I fine-tuned a pre-trained ResNet-50 in PyTorch on about 350 annotated images, freezing the early layers and retraining the final block. I applied standard augmentations to compensate for the small dataset [ai_ml:case:defect-image-classifier].

My first two weeks would focus on evaluation. I would clean a sample of the resume set, agree a scoring rubric for quality and personalisation with your hiring experts, and score baseline GPT-3.5 Turbo outputs before any fine-tuning. Then I would run the first tuning job through the OpenAI API and log each change, including what failed and why, so your team can take over the work cleanly. I would also confirm the access and privacy rules for candidate resume data before touching the dataset.
